title: Pending Founder Decisions
summary: A collection of 32 pending decisions (PFD-001–PFD-032) awaiting founder approval across L1–L5 architecture, spanning validator engine design, task-ID grammar, schema layout, lane planning, and organizational structure.
notes: Classified as ADR per manifest override.
